full.content: The memory text — one standalone fact (write, update, merge).
full.category: Kind of fact (required for write; on update/merge optional, omitted keeps the current category).
full.ids: Memory ids from <project-memory>: one for update, one or more for archive, two or more for merge, 1–20 for get.

light.category: Kind of fact (required for write; optional on update/merge).
light.ids: Ids from <project-memory>: one for update, 1+ for archive, 2+ for merge, 1–20 for get.
